The '''KY12 medium laser cannon''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|medium laser cannon]] that was produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. A turret-mounted KY12 was the primary weapon of the [[BTS-A2 Long-Range Strike Fighter/Bomber]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
